The evidence highlighted that there had been little reflection upon the events leading up to Victor's death, with no facility for the identification of any missed opportunities to provide or obtain care for Victor prior to his final admission to hospital.
lack of reflection on events leading to death

The evidence highlighted that the only internal investigation that took place in respect of the care provided to Victor was in the context of safeguarding and as a consequence of a request from the Local Authority, under section 42 of the Care Act 2014, following the submission of safeguarding referrals by the Hospital after Victor's death.

Although an internal review of the care arrangements in place for Victor took place alongside the internal investigation, the purpose of this was to identify any further opportunities to strengthen existing procedures, rather than to identify any areas of learning and improvements that could have been made in respect of Victor's care.
